+"""Live RoboCasa PnPStoveToCounter client used for this episode.
+
+Actions are deliberately issued in short, observable chunks.  Spatial targets
+are estimated only from the returned RGB-D images and their camera calibration.
+"""
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output")
+CAMERAS = [
+    "robot0_agentview_center",
+    "robot0_agentview_left",
+    "robot0_agentview_right",
+    "robot0_eye_in_hand",
+]
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print("connected:", spec["protocol"], spec["task_text"], "dt", spec["control_dt"])
+
+
+def state(obs=None):
+    """Print the robot's returned proprioception, without simulator state."""
+    if obs is None:
+        obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    p = obs.meta["proprio"]
+    print("time_left_s", round(obs.meta.get("time_left_s", -1), 1),
+          "control_steps", obs.meta.get("control_steps"))
+    print(dict(zip(p["layout"], np.round(p["now"], 4))))
+    return obs
+
+
+def observe(tag="obs", cameras=CAMERAS, depth=True):
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="none")
+    path = OUT / tag
+    obs.save(str(path))
+    print("observed", tag, "time_left_s", round(obs.meta.get("time_left_s", -1), 1))
+    return obs
+
+
+def action(dx=0, dy=0, dz=0, drx=0, dry=0, drz=0, grip=-1,
+           base_x=0, base_y=0, base_yaw=0, torso=0, mode=-1):
+    return np.array([dx, dy, dz, drx, dry, drz, grip,
+                     base_x, base_y, base_yaw, torso, mode], dtype=np.float64)
+
+
+_call = 0
+
+
+def send(rows, tag="step", cameras=CAMERAS, depth=True):
+    global _call
+    _call += 1
+    rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+    if rows.ndim == 1:
+        rows = rows[None, :]
+    assert rows.shape[1] == 12 and len(rows) <= 200
+    obs = r.submit("ee_delta", rows, cameras=cameras, video="none",
+                   include_depth=depth, note=tag)
+    obs.save(str(OUT / f"{_call:02d}_{tag}"))
+    p = obs.meta.get("proprio", {})
+    lay, now = p.get("layout", []), p.get("now", [])
+    ix = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(lay)}
+    print(tag, "steps", obs.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+          "total", obs.meta.get("control_steps"),
+          "left", round(obs.meta.get("time_left_s", -1), 1),
+          "eef", [round(float(now[ix[k]]), 4) for k in
+                  ("eef_right_x", "eef_right_y", "eef_right_z")],
+          "base", [round(float(now[ix[k]]), 4) for k in
+                   ("mobilebase0_joint_mobile_forward_pos",
+                    "mobilebase0_joint_mobile_side_pos",
+                    "mobilebase0_joint_mobile_yaw_pos")],
+          "done", obs.meta.get("done"), obs.meta.get("reason"))
+    return obs
+
+
+def nudge(dx=0, dy=0, dz=0, steps=1, grip=-1, mode=-1):
+    """Approximate a small Cartesian displacement using 5 cm/step scaling."""
+    row = action(dx=dx, dy=dy, dz=dz, grip=grip, mode=mode)
+    return send(np.repeat(row[None, :], steps, axis=0),
+                tag=f"nudge_{dx}_{dy}_{dz}_{steps}")
+
+
+obs = observe("live_initial")
+state(obs)
*** End Patch";
